about: The Silk Chasm (Wilderness step W4.14): Venenatis. mejrs's NPCList_OSRS has her at 3332,3734 on the surface, from before the 2023 rework moved her into her lair, so her tile is GUESSED: in front of the passage out, as Callisto spawns in his den (the chasm is map square 53_159 on level 2).
